scenario: ambiguous project discovery and idea exploration
shortDescription: Turn ambiguous goals into a decision-ready discovery brief
description: Explore alternatives without prematurely committing to implementation, then converge on explicit options and decisions.
positiveTriggers: The goal or solution space is ambiguous
The user asks for alternatives before a plan
boundaries: Do not make product changes
Do not treat ideas as approved execution scope

action: write a versioned plan and task ledger
shortDescription: Decompose approved scope into a versioned execution plan
description: Turn a clarified objective into bounded tasks, dependencies, evidence, risks, blockers, and rollback conditions.
positiveTriggers: A goal needs an executable task ledger
A plan must be prepared for user approval
boundaries: Do not dispatch before approval
Do not hide risks or blockers

action: fan out approved dispatches and reconcile results
outcome: audited parallel execution and fan-in report
shortDescription: Fan out independent tasks and reconcile an audited result
description: Dispatch only independent tasks with isolated workspaces, then synchronize accepted evidence to the parent planning session.
positiveTriggers: Tasks have no hidden dependency or shared mutable writes
A parallel plan is explicitly approved
boundaries: Do not parallelize shared writes
Do not create a parallel branch without a parent series

scenario: one bounded task should be performed by a task worker
action: send a scoped dispatch and collect evidence
shortDescription: Give a task worker bounded scope and collect evidence
description: Use an independent task worker with explicit paths, Skills, stop conditions, and a fixed return destination.
positiveTriggers: A plan task is approved and ready
The execution controller needs a bounded worker
boundaries: Worker cannot self-approve
Worker cannot expand scope

scenario: concurrent task workers need isolated Git workspaces
action: create and audit one worktree per writer
shortDescription: Isolate concurrent writers with auditable Git worktrees
description: Create bounded worktrees for concurrent writers and record paths, branches, cleanup, and merge evidence.
positiveTriggers: Independent tasks write to the same repository
A parallel dispatch needs workspace isolation
boundaries: Do not rewrite another worker's worktree
Do not delete worktrees without approval

scenario: an approved development branch is ready for handoff
action: verify, summarize, and prepare branch completion
shortDescription: Verify a completed branch and prepare its audited handoff
description: Run completion checks, capture evidence, record deviations, and prepare a safe handoff without silently merging.
positiveTriggers: A task or branch reports implementation complete
A handoff or merge decision is requested
boundaries: Do not merge or push without authorization
Do not omit failing checks

scenario: completed work needs an independent review
shortDescription: Prepare an evidence-bound request for independent review
description: Package the exact plan version, acceptance criteria, diff, tests, risks, and questions for an independent reviewer.
positiveTriggers: A worker report is ready for review
The plan requires independent acceptance
boundaries: Do not ask the worker to approve itself
Do not change acceptance criteria in the review request

scenario: an independent review report returns to planning
action: compare evidence with exact acceptance criteria
shortDescription: Evaluate returned evidence and decide the next governed action
description: Record accepted, revision-required, blocked, or failed outcomes without silently changing the approved scope.
positiveTriggers: A reviewer returns a decision
A planning controller must unlock or block a task
boundaries: Do not accept missing evidence
Do not unlock dependents on a blocked decision

scenario: a bounded code change needs test-first implementation
action: write a failing test, implement, and refactor
shortDescription: Drive bounded changes with a red-green-refactor evidence loop
description: Use a test-first loop inside the approved task scope and return the test evidence with the change.
positiveTriggers: The task has a deterministic behavior contract
The project uses automated tests
boundaries: Do not invent acceptance criteria
Do not skip the verification loop

scenario: a reproducible system failure needs diagnosis
action: reproduce, isolate, and report root-cause hypotheses
shortDescription: Reproduce system failures and return evidence-backed diagnosis
description: Investigate a concrete failure with controlled experiments, preserve evidence, and stop at uncertainty instead of guessing.
positiveTriggers: A reproducible system error is reported
The user asks for diagnosis before a fix
boundaries: Do not apply an unapproved production fix
Do not claim root cause without evidence

scenario: a task is about to be marked complete
action: run the declared validation and audit the evidence
shortDescription: Gate completion on declared tests, evidence, and residual risk
description: Check every acceptance criterion, required evidence item, rollback condition, and new risk before completion.
positiveTriggers: A worker reports completion
A dependent task is about to unlock
boundaries: Do not treat self-reported success as evidence
Do not close unresolved blockers

scenario: a plan needs a clear human-readable artifact
action: write a descriptive, searchable plan document
shortDescription: Write descriptive, searchable plans with risks and gates
description: Produce a plan whose title, summary, search terms, knowledge domains, tasks, risks, blockers, and approval request are explicit.
positiveTriggers: A new plan or plan version is requested
Other conversations need to retrieve the plan
boundaries: Do not write an execution command as a plan
Do not omit an empty-section explanation

scenario: a reusable capability needs a new Skill
action: define scenario routing metadata and instructions
shortDescription: Define reusable Skills with explicit routing and boundaries
description: Author a Skill from its scenario, boundaries, inputs, outputs, prerequisites, side effects, category, and risk.
positiveTriggers: No existing Skill reliably matches the scenario
A Skill needs a routing contract
boundaries: Do not create a Skill from a name alone
Do not use authoring to execute product work

scenario: a task needs information from another conversation
action: search indexes, read summaries, and record references
shortDescription: Retrieve cross-session context through indexed summaries
description: Find conversation and plan records through indexes first, read summaries before source turns, and record every reference.
positiveTriggers: The current task depends on another conversation
A plan or knowledge record must be found
boundaries: Do not assume a transcript was shared
Do not use draft memory as an execution fact
